title: Compact price badges, sunset quickstart screens, and model-card callouts for release notes
creator: Samir Patel
description: Design and export a compact set of visual assets for the March catalog release notes: 1) compact price badges that can overlay model tiles at multiple widths and densities, 2) a sunset/legacy banner state for deprecation flows, 3) quickstart-focused model-card callouts (three variants: new model highlight, migration suggestion, fallback recommendation). Deliverables must include light and dark theme variants, 1x and 2x export PNGs, an annotated redline for engineering, and Figma components with tokens. Include asset naming conventions, responsive behavior notes, and localization guidance for up to 12 locales.
review_feedback: PM Marisol: prefer shorter badge labels for narrow breakpoints; request to add cost/estimate tooltip state
Eng Raj: confirm thumbnail export naming for CDN pipeline; request 48px and 72px raster sizes
Docs Maya: ask for one microcopy variant for deprecation ribbon that is less alarmist
